messages:
sara_support: FYI customer ACME reported repeated failures when using our function-calling API. They get a schema validation error only when the model picks the `billing.lookup_account` tool. Happening since ~09:20 UTC. Ticket: #INC-4123

sara_support: error payload from customer: `{'name': 'billing.lookup_account', 'arguments': {'account_id': 12345}}` -> response: `400 Bad Request - invalid_schema: expected string for 'account_id' but got number`

sara_support: repro steps they gave: 1) call /v1/chat with tool candidates enabled 2) use prompt: "Find billing for account 12345" 3) observe toolchoice -> function call -> 400.

dan_eng_ml: pinging @miguel_eng_runtime and @priya_sre. This looks like a tool signature mismatch surfaced by the model choosing the tool. Our tool schema expects `account_id` as a string. Did we change the signature for billing.lookup_account in the last rollout?

miguel_eng_runtime: auto-deploy-bot shows a config push at 1905237600 that updated `billing.*` annotations to explicit `string` types (internal tightening). (reacted :eyes:) Might be the cause. The model may be sending ints for numeric IDs.

priya_sre: I can reproduce locally with the exact prompt — the runtime surfaces the schema validator failure before invoking external tools. Quick log: ```2026-02-18T09:22:11Z ERROR tool_call_validator: schema_mismatch billing.lookup_account {'account_id': 12345} expected type str```

alice_se: Customer wants root cause + mitigation. Can we transform numeric arg -> string on the platform side for backward compat? Is that safe?

dan_eng_ml: For short-term we can coerce ints -> strings for fields named `account_id`/`user_id` across tool calls. I'll open a small hotfix branch. For long-term we should add a model-eval to catch this pattern: the function-calling golden prompt suite should include examples where the model emits ints for IDs so schema tightening CI flags regressions.

miguel_eng_runtime: Agree. I'll revert the config push in staging and add a test case to the tool schema test harness that runs against our golden prompts set. Also adding a runtime tolerant flag `coerce_numeric_ids` behind a kill-switch.

dan_eng_ml: I added an entry in the eval tracker: EVAL-2783 "toolcall: numeric id vs string" and a failing CI snippet: ```FAIL tests/toolcall_golden/test_numeric_id.py::test_billing_lookup
E   AssertionError: expected str for 'account_id' but got int (12345)```

alice_se: Sent a temporary workaround to customer: we translated ints -> strings at the gateway and validated success (their call now returns 200). Customer asked for ETA on permanent fix.

priya_sre: Filing postmortem checklist: 1) revert config push to prod until we vet evals 2) add coerce logic as short-term patch 3) add golden prompt unit to CI 4) notify customers impacted.

miguel_eng_runtime: I'll coordinate the config revert and push the kill-switch. Dan, can you add the CI test and a small golden prompt that makes the model choose `billing.lookup_account` with a numeric ID?

dan_eng_ml: Yep — PR incoming linking EVAL-2783 and CI job change. Also adding an integration test that runs the latest model family + tool signatures to detect drift.

sara_support: Thanks team. I updated ticket #INC-4123 with the workaround and ETA: "short-term coercion deployed, permanent fix in next deployment after CI green (ETA ~4 business days)". Customer replied :thumbsup:.

alice_se: Note for records: this is a good reminder to keep the tool schema test suite tied to golden prompts and model variants — model output types can drift and break strict validators.

auto-deploy-bot: deploy triggered: rollback config-billing-1905237600 -> staging at 1905240100 (status: in_progress)

miguel_eng_runtime: rollback complete on staging. pushing kill-switch to prod in 10m and coordinating with SRE.

priya_sre: I'll monitor for increased errors and CI alerts. If anything spikes, page eng-oncall.

sara_support: closing loop for now, will keep the thread updated once PRs land and prod fix is deployed.
